accuracyFlags: FAQ promises 'dated prices for a cafe brunch, a pub meal, a mid-range dinner and a takeaway' but the table has restaurant meal, fast-food combo, mid-range dinner, cappuccino, soft drink - brunch and pub meal are not present.

Prices are Numbeo community-contributed ranges ('updated June 2026') presented as '2026 meal and coffee prices'; Numbeo is not an official source and 'Prices checked 12 August 2026' overstates verification.
'Public holiday surcharges ... typically around fifteen percent' - legal but typical level uncited.
